name: Jarvis Dependency Security Check
description: Read-only Python dependency advisory check on the executing Jarvis host, with one current Canvas report and deduplicated alerts for findings or incomplete checks. Suitable for weekly scheduling.

steps.description: Collect local package inventories and check current OSV advisories without model calls
Find the durable dependency security report

params.title: ${canvas_title}
params.content:
# Jarvis Dependency Security

## Current Status

Audit status: **${security_status}**. Checked ${security_checked_at}.

${security_summary_markdown}

## Follow-up

Review advisory findings and proposed package updates with Codex before applying changes. Listed fixes require compatibility review. This check does not install packages or restart services.

## Run Log

- ${security_checked_at}: ${security_status}; ${security_packages_queried} package/version pairs queried. Earlier structured results are retained in scheduled run history.
